checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face structure, expression and features are preserved.
Hair is slightly browner/lighter but the curls, sweater and framing are intact.
Trees, path, grass and bench are still visible.
Strong amber/orange cast, faded blacks and visible grain; light leaks go a bit beyond 1970s film.
The image is square and has no text.

faults.what: Heavy orange/yellow light-leak blotches at the left edge and bottom make it look like an instant-photo/Polaroid effect rather than a subtle 1970s movie still.
Her skin is strongly orange and the hair has shifted from near-black to brown.
The agent said it couldn't open the output, and the message offers a blur, which the user didn't ask for.

summary: A warm, grainy, faded retro version that keeps her identity, hair, sweater and park, but the saturated orange light leaks and skin tint are somewhat heavy-handed.
